signIn.title: Your seat at the table
signIn.subtitle: Sign in with the username and password your admin gave you.
signIn.help: You stay signed in on this phone. Forgot your password? Ask an admin to set a new one.

errors.wrongPassword: That username and password don't match. Check them and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
errors.providerDisabled: Signing in isn't available right now.
errors.tooManyCodes: Too many wrong invite codes. Try again in an hour.
errors.usernameTaken: That username is taken. Choose another one.
errors.forbidden: You're not allowed to manage this player's account.
errors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.weakPassword: Choose a longer password (at least 8 characters).

profileSetup.title: Who's playing?
profileSetup.subtitle: This is how the other players see you on the scoreboard.
profileSetup.nameHint: Your first name or what the table calls you.
profileSetup.avatarNote: Your initials are your avatar. Photos are coming later.

pinSetup.title: Set your PIN
pinSetup.subtitle: Your 4-digit PIN is your signature at the table: you'll use it to accept games and confirm scores.
pinSetup.mismatch: The PINs didn't match. Choose your PIN again.
pinSetup.hint: Don't share it. Nobody should type your PIN for you.
pinSetup.biometricBody: Unlock your PIN with your face or fingerprint instead of typing it. Your PIN stays on this phone, protected by the system.

club.setupSubtitle: Join your club with the invite code from a member, or start a new club.
club.codeHint: 6 letters and numbers. Ask any member, or scan their QR code.
club.scanSubtitle: Find it in Club settings on a member's phone.
club.scanHint: Point the camera at the QR code.
club.scanForeign: That isn't a club invite. Try another QR code.
club.cameraBody: Allow the camera to scan a club invite. You can always type the code instead.
club.createNote: You'll be the owner. The club starts with the house rules: target 2000, +100 for the exact cut. You can change them in Club settings.
club.wrongAccount: Signed in with the wrong account?
club.joinSubtitle: Enter the invite code or scan the club's QR code.
club.linkBody: You were invited with this code. You'll see the club's games, players and history once you join.
club.linkInvalidBody: Ask a club member for a new code or QR.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.body: You can sign in again any time with your username and password.
